collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — FEARS AND DOUBTS (FEA-01..50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fears big and small, sensible and not, self-doubt, feeling like a fraud, dread with no reason, wanting and fearing the same thing, and courage that is still frightened. Nobody has to be brave, nobody is mocked, and a fear does not have to be conquered by the end.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks a child aged 12-13 and an adult)

collection.description: A child nearly fourteen does not want to grow up yet: say there is no hurry, or say you felt the same.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) will be fourteen soon, and people keep saying things like "You're nearly grown!" and "Soon you'll be doing real work!" (subject) does not feel nearly grown. (subject.He/she) still likes climbing trees and playing in the stream. Today (subject.he/she) tells (friend), "I don't want to be grown up yet."

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: "I felt exactly like that," says (friend). "I think everyone does." (subject) is amazed. "What happened?" "I got older anyway, and some of it was good, and I still miss being little sometimes." (subject) thinks about that. It isn't a comfort exactly. It's honest, and that's better.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: "Then don't be," says (friend). "Being grown isn't a door you go through. You do it slowly. Climb trees as long as you want." (subject) looks doubtful. "Do grown-ups climb trees?" (friend) thinks. Then (friend.he/she) walks over to the nearest tree and climbs it, badly. (subject) laughs so hard (subject.he/she) has to sit down.
